ns2:course.label: Topics in Literature and Culture
ns2:course.description: Introductory study of variety of topics in literature and culture, including those that bridge traditional historical periods, focus on themes or movements, and cross disciplinary boundaries. May be repeated up to 6 hours, if topics vary. Prerequisite: Completion of the Composition I requirement.
